snowdb01.yoursite.mil: MariaDB refused the login of monitor (the MariaDB monitor credential) in container snowdb: Access denied for user 'monitor'@'localhost' (using password: YES) - most likely its password is wrong for this container

# the login by hand (it asks for the password):
podman exec -it snowdb mariadb -u monitor -p -e "SELECT 1"
# one read-only monitor account, the same password in every container (as an admin, in each container; then the MariaDB monitor credential has its name and password):
podman exec -it snowdb mariadb -u root -p -e "CREATE USER 'monitor'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '<password>'; GRANT PROCESS, REPLICA MONITOR ON *.* TO 'monitor'@'localhost'"
# (MariaDB before 10.5.9: PROCESS, REPLICATION CLIENT; MySQL: PROCESS, REPLICATION CLIENT)
